pinDefaults.template:
Decide how this note changes what the notebook knows.

Note: {{note}}

Extraction from the note:
{{extraction}}

Candidate existing entities per mention (refer to them by index in each list):
{{candidates}}

Context packet (entities with their active claims, open tasks, similar notes; refer to existing claims and open tasks by their index in these lists):
{{packet}}

For each mention decide reuse (give the candidate index), create, merge (give two candidate indexes) or unsure. For each extracted claim (by index) say whether it is new, restates, refines, supersedes or contradicts an existing claim (give its index). For each extracted task (by index) say which open task it closes, if any. Write an updated one-paragraph summary for an entity only when the note changes what is known, and one sentence summarising the revision.

Rules:
- Use only the note and the provided context; never invent entities or dates.
- Prefer reusing an existing entity when the candidate list contains it; create sparingly.
- Keep names as written by the author; put variants in aliases.
- Quote evidence verbatim; one claim per statement; no inferred hierarchy.
- When unsure whether two things are the same, answer `unsure` rather than guessing.
- Output JSON only, matching the schema.
